name: What should I consider before starting a primary bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before starting a primary bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before starting a primary bathroom remodel, consider your budget, desired timeline, and must-have features. Think about how you use the space daily and what functional improvements would enhance your routine. Research design styles and materials that appeal to you, and gather inspiration from luxury home publications or websites. Also, consider the long-term value your remodel will add to your home. A clear vision and detailed plan will guide the project effectively and help you communicate your needs to your design-build team.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before remodeling, consider your budget, timeline, desired features, functional improvements, design style, and how the remodel adds long-term value.
